title: damage children's psychological well-being
meaning_vi: gây tổn hại đến sức khỏe tâm lý của trẻ

examples.en: Constant criticism from parents can damage children's psychological well-being and erode their self-confidence.

title: associate learning with fear rather than curiosity
term: associate learning with fear rather than curiosity
pronunciation: /əˈsəʊʃɪeɪt ˈlɜːnɪŋ wɪð fɪər ˈrɑːðər ðæn ˌkjʊəriˈɒsəti/
meaning_vi: gắn việc học với nỗi sợ hãi thay vì sự tò mò

examples.en: Children who are punished for poor grades may come to associate learning with fear rather than curiosity.
